verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online Advanced advertises custom workflows (docs-4), and a community user confirms built-in automatic rules for transaction categorization (comm-3). Other automations like payment reminders and expense sorting appear to be preset features, not user-defined event→action rules (docs-15, docs-28). Missing for 10: documentation of how rules and workflows are defined (triggers, conditions, actions), event coverage beyond bank transactions, webhook or API event triggers, and hands-on evidence of custom workflow depth.
